name: phases-update
objective: ship features Owner agreed to up front, without Owner having to correct them

stages.name: capture
stages.purpose: Owner and Agent agree on what the change does before it is built

steps.name: write the spec
steps.instruction: Write docs/spec-<issue number>.md: what the change does, and how Owner can see that it works. Write no code yet.

steps.name: Owner approves the spec
steps.instruction: Show Owner the spec, and ask Owner to approve it.

stages.name: build
stages.purpose: the change works as the approved spec says

steps.name: write the code and its test
steps.instruction: Build what the approved spec says, with a test for it under test/. Run npm test until it is green.

steps.name: note the change
steps.instruction: Add one line to CHANGES.md saying what changed.

rules.rule: the spec says what changes and how Owner can see it works
every new function has a test, and npm test is green
CHANGES.md has a line for the change
